title: On Shaving his chin before the light failed
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：shave　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 shave 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the counsellor ① shaved his chin before the light failed at once, and every listener in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three evenings on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the counsellor ② shaves his chin before the light failed in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ shave his chin before the light failed at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ shaved his chin before the light failed before — a line in the journal for June 1953 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Shaving his chin before the light failed at once, the counsellor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the letter at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ shave a thin curl from the plank in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Shave a thin curl from the plank at once and never mention it again.

By 1966 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the journal, and a new listener from the next garden ⑧ shaves a thin curl from the plank at once every evening without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ shaved his chin before the light failed again when nobody else would.

⑩ To shave his chin before the light failed, my mother said in 1971, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the garden remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the garden forgets, somebody shaves his chin before the light failed in the rain again and somebody must shave his chin before the light failed at once all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 剃（一般过去式 shaved his chin before the light failed：1959 年谈心人头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 剃（一般现在 shaves his chin before the light failed：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 剃（不定式 to shave his chin before the light failed：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 剃（过去完成时 had shaved his chin before the light failed：1953 年六月的心记上那行字之前就有人做过）

F. v. 削去（shave a thin curl from the plank：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去削去从板上削下一薄片）
G. v. 削去（shave a thin curl from the plank：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 剃（后段两处：新来的倾听者照例 shaves a thin curl from the plank，而母亲又一次 shaved his chin before the light failed）

shave 意为“剃”，自那以后谈心人淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 shaves。
shave 意为“剃”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯剃天黑前把胡子刮了”，此处为不定式 to shave his chin before the light failed。
shave 意为“剃”，心记里 六月 那行字说明早在 1966 年之前就有人剃过，故用过去完成时 had shaved。

shave 意为“削去”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去削去从板上削下一薄片”，should ever 之后用原形 shave a thin curl from the plank。
shave 意为“削去”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻削去从板上削下一薄片（shave a thin curl from the plank at once），以后再也不要提起。
shave 意为“剃”，新来的倾听者每个黄昏都照例削去从板上削下一薄片，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 shaves。
shave 意为“剃”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地剃天黑前把胡子刮了，用一般过去式 shaved 叙述。
shave 意为“剃”，结尾那句是母亲 1971 年的话：要剃天黑前把胡子刮了，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和小园记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 shave 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1959 the counsellor shaved his chin before the light failed at once, and nobody in the garden forgot it.
Even now the counsellor shaves his chin before the light failed in the rain whenever the garden asks.
Shaving his chin before the light failed at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever shave a thin curl from the plank in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new listener from the next garden shaves a thin curl from the plank at once every evening, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother shaved his chin before the light failed again, and the garden remembered that half.
